\section{WebCoder --- System
Architecture}\label{webcoder--system-architecture}

\begin{quote}
One-paragraph summary: WebCoder is a bilingual (RO/EN + 10 more UI
locales) competitive-programming platform --- a Next.js 16 front end
over a Django 6 / DRF API, a Celery-driven judge that executes untrusted
code inside a hardened Docker sandbox through a filtering socket proxy,
and a Postgres+Redis state layer. This guide is for engineers who need
to understand, run, or extend the system; each section maps to code you
can open today.
\end{quote}

\textbf{Who it\textquotesingle s for:} backend/frontend contributors,
operators deploying the stack, and anyone evaluating the
platform\textquotesingle s design. The Romanian twin of this guide is
\href{../guide-ro/ARHITECTURA.md}{\texttt{docs/guide-ro/ARHITECTURA.md}}.

\begin{center}\rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.5pt}\end{center}

Next.js 16 app & repo root \texttt{src/}, App Router & SSR/ISR pages,

PostgreSQL 16 & compose \texttt{postgres} & system of record (no host

Redis & compose \texttt{redis} & celery broker, throttle cache, judge

celery-worker & compose \texttt{celery-worker} & judge + default queues;
\texttt{acks\_late} with stale-in-progress guard \\
judge-runner & \texttt{backend/Dockerfile.judge} & sandboxed toolchains:

socket-proxy & compose overlay default & docker API filter ---
containers/exec POST only; everything else 403 \\

recompute, notification purge, output retention, weekly digest,

db-backup & compose sidecar & daily \texttt{pg\_dump\ -Fc}, 7d/4w/6m
retention \\

\texttt{credentials:\ \textquotesingle{}include\textquotesingle{}}; the
catalog list is ISR-cached 60 s server-side (disabled under
\texttt{E2E\_API\_BASE}).

\subsection{2. The judge pipeline}\label{2-the-judge-pipeline}

\pandocbounded{\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={Judge
pipeline}]{C:/Users/Prekzursil/.zcode/workspace/draft-9cac9da0-09ed-462a-8bd2-a78591461ba4/wt-polish/docs/dist/ARCHITECTURE/en/43ae7a19bbb00e46ba5e5a0f957026d485dd035b.png}}

\emph{Source:
\href{../diagrams/judge-pipeline.mmd}{\texttt{docs/diagrams/judge-pipeline.mmd}}}

Key invariants (all enforced in code, \texttt{backend/submissions/}):

\begin{enumerate}
\def\labelenumi{\arabic{enumi}.}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Language registry}
  (\texttt{submissions/judge\_utils/languages.py}) is the single source
  of truth --- compile/run commands, per-language time multipliers (e.g.
  python ×3), memory floors, toolchain pins mirrored on
  \texttt{/api/v1/public/languages/}.
\item
  \textbf{Every judged run} is \texttt{-\/-network\ none} with a
  read-only submission mount, all capabilities dropped, uid 1000
  (\texttt{backend/judge\_utils/}, \texttt{Dockerfile.judge}).
\item
  \textbf{Verdict ladder} per test: TLE (wall vs CPU), MLE (max-RSS
  ladder incl. exit-137 + ≥0.9×limit), RE (signal-mapped messages), WA,
  AC --- fabrication triggers were deleted in the judge-fairness wave.
\item
  \textbf{Comparison modes}: EXACT / STRIP / LINES\_STRIP / TOKEN /
  float-epsilon (\texttt{problems/models.Problem.ComparisonMode}), plus
  custom checkers speaking the exit-7
  \texttt{POINTS\ \textless{}0..1\textgreater{}} partial protocol
  (testlib-compatible).
\item
  \textbf{Scoring modes}: BINARY, PARTIAL\_PER\_TEST, SUBTASKS (DMOJ
  all-members rule).
\item
  \textbf{Feedback gating}: sample tests expose input+expected for
  diffing; hidden tests strip outputs for non-privileged viewers;
  per-test time/memory bars are persisted on every result row.
\item
  \textbf{Custom libraries}: pip install happens in a one-shot container
  on an internal \texttt{judge-build} network whose only egress is a
  pre-seeded pypi allowlist proxy --- fail-closed by default (RUNBOOK
  §judge-pip-egress).
\end{enumerate}

\subsection{3. Data model (core slice)}\label{3-data-model-core-slice}

\pandocbounded{\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={Data
model}]{C:/Users/Prekzursil/.zcode/workspace/draft-9cac9da0-09ed-462a-8bd2-a78591461ba4/wt-polish/docs/dist/ARCHITECTURE/en/22ac648fe9cee6cdb213cb70532bd38ea88a61b6.png}}

\emph{Source:
\href{../diagrams/data-model.mmd}{\texttt{docs/diagrams/data-model.mmd}}}

Modeling notes:

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  Localized fields are JSON objects keyed by locale with \textbf{English
  mandatory} (\texttt{problems/i18n\_fields.py} owner rule (b)); RO is
  the home-market language; the i18n-10 wave added 10 more UI locales
  for statements/titles.
\item
  \texttt{Submission} → \texttt{SubmissionTestResult} carries per-test
  verdict, time, memory, \textbf{and the applied limits} (judge-fairness
  receipts).
\item
  \texttt{Problem.reference\_solution\_code} powers hack counter-tests,
  testcase-strength scoring and the hidden-suite generator
  (\texttt{boost\_hidden\_tests}).
\item
  Import provenance (\texttt{source\_url}, \texttt{source\_authors},
  \texttt{ImportSource} ledger) records where content came from and
  under what terms (CNT-2).
\end{itemize}

\subsection{4. Auth \& cookie flow}\label{4-auth--cookie-flow}

\pandocbounded{\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={Auth cookie
flow}]{C:/Users/Prekzursil/.zcode/workspace/draft-9cac9da0-09ed-462a-8bd2-a78591461ba4/wt-polish/docs/dist/ARCHITECTURE/en/cc037c783b21e881ab154a672178aa2c479382a7.png}}

\emph{Source:
\href{../diagrams/auth-cookie-flow.mmd}{\texttt{docs/diagrams/auth-cookie-flow.mmd}}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \texttt{wc\_access} (5 min) + \texttt{wc\_refresh} (24 h) are
  \textbf{httpOnly cookies} --- never in \texttt{localStorage}; rotation
  blacklists the old refresh (\texttt{backend/users/}, dj-rest-auth).
\item
  Unsafe methods require the double-submit \texttt{X-CSRFToken} (cookie
  via \texttt{GET\ /api/v1/auth/csrf/}).
\item
  Non-browser clients use Bearer tokens and personal API tokens (public
  API, 60/min; tokened 240/min).
\item
  Roles: BASIC, CREATOR, TEACHER, VERIFIER, ADMIN
  (\texttt{users/models.Roles}); minors\textquotesingle{} profiles
  default non-public (LEG-2).
\end{itemize}

\subsection{5. Contest lifecycle}\label{5-contest-lifecycle}

\pandocbounded{\includegraphics[keepaspectratio,alt={Contest
lifecycle}]{C:/Users/Prekzursil/.zcode/workspace/draft-9cac9da0-09ed-462a-8bd2-a78591461ba4/wt-polish/docs/dist/ARCHITECTURE/en/4a43b15d698febc064a1849ebdfbbe41130eb965.png}}

\emph{Source:
\href{../diagrams/contest-lifecycle.mmd}{\texttt{docs/diagrams/contest-lifecycle.mmd}}}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \texttt{contest\_tick} (beat, every minute) drives state transitions;
  formats are strategy classes (IOI sum-of-best is the default; ICPC
  penalty and AtCoder-style exist).
\item
  Freeze is a query filter on the scoreboard; ratings commit
  post-contest via Glicko with AtCoder-style display suppression for
  newcomers.
\item
  Upsolving/virtual participation re-opens problems under a personal
  clock; hacks unlock after a full board solve.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{6. Cross-cutting mechanics}\label{6-cross-cutting-mechanics}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Pagination}: every list endpoint uses standard/cursor
  pagination (\texttt{webcoder\_api/pagination.py}).
\item
  \textbf{Throttles}: anon 60/min, user 240/min, scoped \texttt{auth}
  10/min, \texttt{submit} 20/h, scratch/guest/sample-run scopes;
  counters in redis (shared across processes).
\item
  \textbf{Observability}: \texttt{/healthz}, \texttt{/readyz}
  (db+cache+broker), admin metrics snapshot, JSON logs
  (\texttt{LOG\_JSON=1}).
\item
  \textbf{Reproducibility}: \texttt{export\_catalog} /
  \texttt{import\_catalog} (+ release-asset snapshot) rebuild the
  imported catalog deterministically; \texttt{seed\_problems} rebuilds
  the starter pack; \texttt{boost\_hidden\_tests} regenerates hidden
  suites from committed specs.
\item
  \textbf{Testing}: pytest (sqlite CI profile, 100 \% line coverage,
  zero warnings), vitest, Playwright mock-mode + real-stack mode
  (\texttt{E2E\_API\_BASE}).
\end{itemize}

\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}
